mostWorthwhile.text: Fitting the canopy was most worthwhile: it completed the roof and revealed the carousel in motion.

leastWorthwhile.text: The repeated pole-and-horse fittings were clear but predictable, especially by the cream horse.

surprise.text: The completed carousel showed the horses travelling around the turning deck; I had expected the roof, but not specifically described motion.

arbitrary.text: Choosing between identical-looking poles felt arbitrary, though fitting one through each horse had a clear purpose.

continue.text: I would probably continue to see another finished moving construction, although I would hope for less repetition.
